title: Glowing treasure chest
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='45%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0.15'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='coinG' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff9c4'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd54f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffb300'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='46' ry='38' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- chest lid -->
  <path d='M18 48 Q18 26 50 26 Q82 26 82 48 Z' fill='#8d5524' stroke='#c68642' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- lid highlight -->
  <path d='M22 46 Q22 30 50 30 Q78 30 78 46 Z' fill='#a06a33'/>
  <!-- lid band -->
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='22' rx='2' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <rect x='46' y='26' width='8' height='22' rx='2' fill='none' stroke='#ffe082' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- chest body -->
  <rect x='18' y='48' width='64' height='30' rx='3' fill='#a0522d' stroke='#c68642' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='22' y='51' width='56' height='24' rx='2' fill='#b5652e'/>

  <!-- vertical bands -->
  <rect x='30' y='48' width='6' height='30' fill='#c9a227'/>
  <rect x='64' y='48' width='6' height='30' fill='#c9a227'/>

  <!-- lock -->
  <rect x='44' y='52' width='12' height='14' rx='2' fill='#ffd54f' stroke='#fff9c4' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#8d5524'/>
  <rect x='49' y='59' width='2' height='4' fill='#8d5524'/>

  <!-- glowing light from crack -->
  <path d='M18 48 Q50 40 82 48' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='3' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M20 60 Q50 52 80 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffe066' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- coins spilling -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='4' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='75' r='3.5' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='71' r='4' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='76' r='3' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='76' r='3.5' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='79' r='2.5' fill='url(#coinG)'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='80' r='3' fill='url(#coinG)'/>

  <!-- gems -->
  <polygon points='36,68 39,64 42,68 39,71' fill='#66e0ff'/>
  <polygon points='36,68 39,64 42,68 39,71' fill='none' stroke='#ccf7ff' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <polygon points='64,67 67,63 70,67 67,70' fill='#ff7be5'/>
  <polygon points='64,67 67,63 70,67 67,70' fill='none' stroke='#ffc2f2' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M25 38 L26 35 L27 38 L30 39 L27 40 L26 43 L25 40 L22 39 Z' fill='#fffde7'/>
  <path d='M74 34 L75 32 L76 34 L78 35 L76 36 L75 38 L74 36 L72 35 Z' fill='#fffde7'/>
  <path d='M50 20 L51 17 L52 20 L55 21 L52 22 L51 25 L50 22 L47 21 Z' fill='#ffe066'/>

  <!-- little glow dots -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='56' r='1.5' fill='#ffe066' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='1' fill='#fffde7' opacity='0.9'/>
</svg>
